name: Helen Chenoweth-Hage
summary: Helen Margaret Chenoweth-Hage (née Palmer; born January 27, 1938 – October 2, 2006) was an American  politician from the U.S. state of Idaho, serving three terms in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1995 to 2001. She remains one of two women  to ever represent Idaho in the United States Congress and the only one from the Republican Party.
